parts.label: (a)
parts.stem:
When $\mathbf{G}$, $\text{C}_4\text{H}_{10}\text{O}$, is heated, thermal decomposition occurs.

$$\text{C}_4\text{H}_{10}\text{O(g)} \rightarrow \text{C}_2\text{H}_6\text{(g)} + \text{CO(g)} + \text{CH}_4\text{(g)} \quad \Delta H = -7.00\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
The atoms in a molecule of CO are held together by a triple covalent bond. One of these bonds is a coordinate (dative covalent) bond.

Draw a dot-and-cross diagram to show the arrangement of outer electrons in a CO molecule.

Use $\bullet$ to represent electrons from an oxygen atom.

Use $\times$ to represent electrons from a carbon atom.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
Calculate the bond energy of $\text{C}\equiv\text{O}$ using the bond energy values in Table 3.1 and the enthalpy change, $\Delta H$, for the thermal decomposition of $\mathbf{G}$. Show your working.

Table 3.1

| bond | bond energy/$\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| $\text{C}-\text{C}$ | 350 |
| $\text{C}-\text{O}$ (in $\mathbf{G}$) | 360 |
| $\text{C}-\text{H}$ | 410 |

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
When $\mathbf{G}$, $\text{C}_4\text{H}_{10}\text{O}$, is heated in a sealed container, an equilibrium mixture is produced.

$$\text{C}_4\text{H}_{10}\text{O(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{C}_2\text{H}_6\text{(g)} + \text{CO(g)} + \text{CH}_4\text{(g)}$$

Complete the expression for the equilibrium constant, $K_{\text{c}}$, for this reaction. State the units of $K_{\text{c}}$.

parts.text:
Thermal decomposition of $\mathbf{G}$ in the presence of $\text{I}_2$ affects the activation energy, $E_{\text{a}}$, for the reaction. Table 3.2 shows $E_{\text{a}}$ for the thermal decomposition of $\mathbf{G}$ with and without $\text{I}_2$.

Table 3.2

| reaction | $E_{\text{a}}$ (with $\text{I}_2$)/$\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ | $E_{\text{a}}$/$\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $\text{C}_4\text{H}_{10}\text{O(g)} \rightarrow \text{C}_2\text{H}_6\text{(g)} + \text{CO(g)} + \text{CH}_4\text{(g)}$ | 143 | 224 |

State what effect adding $\text{I}_2$ to the reaction mixture has on the value of $K_{\text{c}}$. Explain your answer.
